opening.argument: The video presents BitConnect as a route to wealth through crypto, while directing viewers toward continued participation in its lending investment flow. Its title promises how to become rich through crypto, and the speaker describes "reinvesting my lending profits" while reporting "160 dollars in active investment." The process is not a completed withdrawal or a demonstrated loss; it is an active reinvestment arrangement in which capital remains committed. The speaker confirms that "capital release will be after 290 days of course" and reports successfully reinvesting 10 dollars, tying the claimed returns and participation to retaining funds in the platform. These facts establish the promoted investment-pool structure while leaving no basis to claim a completed loss or outcome for viewers.
